page_title: REN 1-0 MAR | Rennes v Marseille 15/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
90+6' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+4' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' Timothy Weah (Marseille) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
90+1' 1 - 0 Ludovic Blas (Rennes) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the bottom left corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
89' PENALTY APPEAL by Rennes, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
88' 1:12 – the corner kicks stats.
86' That will be all from Amine Gouiri (Marseille) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Robinio Vaz.
86' It's time for a substitution. Darryl Bakola (Marseille) comes on in place of Angel Gomes.
86' Substitution. Seko Fofana leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
85' Habib Beye has decided to make a change. Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) replaces Przemyslaw Frankowski.
84' A substitution has been made. Mousa Tamari is replaced by Ibrahim Salah (Rennes).
84' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
83' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Marseille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' The resulting set piece from Marseille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
82' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle as Valentin Rongier (Rennes) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
80' Angel Gomes (Marseille) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the left post.
78' Michael Murillo will be replaced by Ulisses Garcia (Marseille).
78' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
76' Rennes keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
74' Timothy Weah (Marseille) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
72' Timothy Weah (Marseille) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
70' A cooling break is underway.
70' Michael Murillo (Marseille) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Brice Samba is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
68' Total attempts – 7:16.

66' Brice Samba pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
66' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
65' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Marseille force their opponents to concede a corner.
64' Substitution. Fabian Rieder walks off the pitch and Mahdi Camara (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.
63' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Jonathan Rowe is replaced by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille).
63' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.

61' That didn't go as planned! Mousa Tamari (Rennes) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Geronimo Rulli, who easily kept it out.
60' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar.
60' A player from Rennes brings down an opponent and commits a foul. A free kick is awarded to Marseille.
58' Michael Murillo (Marseille) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!
56' The Rennes players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
55' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
51' Some great controlled play and passing from Marseille. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a switch. Timothy Weah is coming on in place of Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

45+6' What a great touch by Adrien Rabiot (Marseille)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
45+5' The statistic for corner kicks – 1:5.
45+3' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
45+2' Marseille are seeing far more of the ball now.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

43' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Geronimo Rulli and his nice save.
41' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Mason Greenwood (Marseille), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
39' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) works the corner short.
38' The corner from Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is intercepted by the defence.

38' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Marseille will have a corner.
37' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christopher Wooh (Rennes) replaces Mohamed Meite.

37' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) talks out of turn to the referee and subsequently receives a yellow card. His behaviour towards the referee was not friendly. He should be thankful, it could have been much worse!
35' The current number of offsides is 4:0.
33' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul.
31' He’s off! Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) gets his marching orders from referee Jeremie Pignard after the VAR review.
31' No action against Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes), and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Jeremie Pignard got that spot on. VAR seen to good effect there!
31' It’s not actually clear who made that challenge, so referee Jeremie Pignard will consult VAR before possibly issuing a red card.
29' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
28' Michael Murillo (Marseille) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
24' Marseille exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
22' The referee blows for a cooling break.
21' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Amine Gouiri (Marseille), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
18' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.
16' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
14' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
13' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) picks up a long through ball, but Brice Samba deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
11' The ratio of the ball possession is 24:76.
9' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
8' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
7' Marseille hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
5' One of the players from Rennes times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
3' Rennes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Marseille will have the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard is the one to supervise the game today.
